note: Hand curation for scripts/build-commentaries.mjs. The deriver reads TITLES, which is a heuristic, not evidence — this file is where its mistakes are corrected and never re-derived. Edit freely; the deriver never writes here.
rule: A work enters the map when its title names a biblical book AND the title either carries a commentary-genre word or governs the book with in/super. The biblical texts THEMSELVES (Liber Genesis, Evangelium secundum Joannem, Psalterium) satisfy neither and are excluded by the rule, not by this list.

reject.550: Epistola ad Joannem — letter to a person named John, not the Gospel/Epistles
reject.2529: Epistola ad Joannem Hierosolymorum — letter to John of Jerusalem
reject.4995: Epistola ad Joannem — letter to a person
reject.5002: Epistola ad Joannem Dolensem — letter to a person
reject.6573: Epistola ad Joannem Saresberiensem — letter to John of Salisbury
reject.596: Contra Joannem Hierosolymitanum — polemic against a person
reject.21535: Liber adversus Joannem Scotum — polemic against John Scotus Eriugena
reject.6345: Epistola ad Matthaeum de variis quaestionibus — letter to a person named Matthew
reject.4070: Epistola ad imperatricem Judith — letter to the empress Judith, not the book
reject.2549: Versus in natali Machabaeorum martyrum — verses for the martyrs' feast, not on 1-2 Maccabees
reject.6269: In verba Evangelii — on unspecified gospel words; names no book
reject.774: De opere Augustini in Psalmos — about Augustine's Enarrationes, not on the Psalms

kind._note: Works that are apparatus TO a commentary rather than commentary on the book. Shown, but labelled, so the page does not present a preface as an exposition.

addBooks._note: workIdno -> [OSIS] for works whose title does not name the book but which ARE commentaries on it. None yet; add as they surface.
